name: Tango-Amanohashidate-Oeyama Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 丹後天橋立大江山国定公園
aliases: 丹後天橋立大江山国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of northern Kyoto: the Amanohashidate sandbar — one of Japan's three great views — the Tango coast and the Oeyama peaks.
notes: Managed by Kyoto. The sandbar viewpoint at Kasamatsu Park and the Monju coast are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
